meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. This is a plain-English summary of each state's rules of professional conduct, kept for marketing planning, and rules change. Check the rule text, your state bar's ethics opinions and your own counsel before you agree a fee split or pay for a referral.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.title: Version 1.2.0
changes.summary: The files carry the 47 jurisdictions whose fee-division and referral-payment rules were both read at the official source, each with its quote. No published record changed.

changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: Record-specific columns moved from referral.csv to referral-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; every figure is unchanged.

changes.title: Method correction
changes.summary: The 1.0.0 records for two states were removed from this release. No other record changed.

changes.title: First release
changes.summary: Fee-division (Rule 1.5(e) or its equivalent) and referral-payment (Rule 7.2(b) or its equivalent) rules for every state and DC, each read at the official source on 2026-10-27, with quotes.
